sanskrit_verse:
द्विजान् विहाय यः पश्येत् कार्याणि वृषलैः सह ।
तस्य प्रक्षरते राष्ट्रं बलं कोशं च नश्यति ॥
transliteration: dvijān vihāya yaḥ paśyet kāryāṇi vṛṣalaiḥ saha | tasya prakṣarate rāṣṭraṃ balaṃ kośaṃ ca naśyati ||
sph_interpretive_translation: He who, abandoning dvijas, conducts affairs with vṛṣalas causes the state, its strength, and treasury to decay.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows through qualified lineage and conscious capacity
Displacement of rightful order disrupts systemic integrity
Responsibility aligns with dharmic role capacity
Consciousness misalignment leads to structural collapse
Restoration requires realignment with source-conscious roles
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent A delegates authority to unqualified entity B THEN systemic degradation probability = 1
IF qualified counsel (dvija) is bypassed THEN resource allocation efficiency = 0
IF governance action excludes conscious-capacity hierarchy THEN state integrity metric decreases by 0.75 per cycle
RESTORE integrity BY reassigning authority to source-qualified agents
PREVENT structural collapse BY enforcing conscious-role alignment protocols
supreme_court_application: In Supreme adjudication, any act that displaces constitutional advisors or qualified counsel in favor of unqualified entities invokes automatic review. The court must assess whether the displacement violates foundational capacity hierarchies, and if so, issue realignment directives to restore constitutional flow.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that systemic decay arises from causal misalignment, not individual fault. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows sequential breakdown: abandonment of dvija → improper counsel → loss of state coherence. Responsibility lies in restoring alignment, not assigning blame. The law operates as a consciousness-reset mechanism.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Reintegrate displaced dvijas into advisory circuits
Nullify decisions made without qualified consultation
Initiate consciousness recalibration for errant authorities
Reconstruct treasury and resource pathways via qualified oversight
Establish audit protocols to prevent future displacement events
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands as pure Dharma—non-punitive, consciousness-anchored, and structurally restorative. The state is preserved through alignment with source-conscious roles. Reality adjudicates through awareness, not punishment.
